conventions.right: answer equals the FEVEROUS label; NOT ENOUGH INFO on a supported or refuted claim is wrong
conventions.bootstrap: paired: the same claim resamples for every condition; percentile interval (2.5th to 97.5th)

retrieval_share.note: The database times were measured with the CPU capped at 50% and the GPU at 2,100 MHz. The RAG run embedded its claims on the CPU; the stated embedding time was measured on cuda.

multihop.scope: supported and refuted claims of the original run, NOT ENOUGH INFO left out; equal weight = the mean of the supported and the refuted figure
